item.title: How to install packages with yarn in Node.js
item.description: Installing packages with yarn provides faster, more reliable dependency management with deterministic installs and better caching than npm. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve used yarn for thousands of Node.js projects to manage dependencies reliably. From my expertise, the most effective approach is using yarn add with proper dependency categorization. This method ensures consistent installations across environments with automatic lockfile generation.
